population_stratum_assign: Holds population stratum assignment records; grain = one row per stratum assignment (stratum_assign_sequence_number) with keys/ids: stratum_assign_sequence_number, stratum_sequence_number, plot_sequence_number, state_code, inventory_year, survey_unit_code, county_code, phase_2_plot_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_identifier, estimation_unit, stratum_code; includes audit columns stratum_assign_created_by, stratum_assign_created_date, stratum_assign_created_in_instance, stratum_assign_modified_by, stratum_assign_modified_date, stratum_assign_modified_in_instance.
plot: Holds plot-level measurements and metadata; grain = one row per plot (plot_sequence_number) with keys/ids: plot_sequence_number, survey_sequence_number, county_sequence_number, previous_plot_sequence_number, plot_inventory_year, plot_state_code, plot_survey_unit_code, plot_county_code, plot_phase_2_plot_number; notable measures: measurement_year, measurement_month, measurement_day, latitude, longitude, elevation, phase_2_panel_number, phase_3_panel_number, ecological_subsection_code, congressional_district_code, manual_version_number, sample_kind_code and related names, plot_status_code and nonsampled reason codes, water_on_plot_code and various design/coding fields, quality_assurance_status.
plot_tree: Holds plot-level contextual fields repeated for trees (plot-tree join context); grain = one row per plot context for tree records (identified by plot_sequence_number and survey_sequence_number) with keys/ids: plot_sequence_number, survey_sequence_number, county_sequence_number, previous_plot_sequence_number, plot_inventory_year, plot_state_code, plot_survey_unit_code, plot_county_code, plot_phase_2_plot_number; notable measures: measurement_year, measurement_month, measurement_day, latitude, longitude, elevation, phase_2_panel_number, phase_3_panel_number, sample_kind_code and names, plot_status_code, quality_assurance_status and other plot-level coded fields.
tree: Holds individual tree measurements and attributes; grain = one row per tree (tree_sequence_number) with keys/ids: tree_sequence_number, plot_sequence_number, previous_tree_sequence_number, tree_inventory_year, tree_state_code, tree_survey_unit_code, tree_county_code, tree_phase_2_plot_number, subplot_number, tree_record_number; notable measures/attributes: species_code, species_common_name, species_scientific_name, species_group_code, current_diameter, total_height, actual_height, diameter_height_code, height_method_code, tree_status_code and names, condition_class_number, azimuth, horizontal_distance, tree_class_code, crown metrics (compacted_crown_ratio, crown_class_code), damage/cause fields (cause_death_agent_code, damage_location_1, damage_type_1), rotten_and_missing_cull.
population_stratum: Holds definition and expansion factors for population strata; grain = one row per stratum (stratum_sequence_number) with keys/ids: stratum_sequence_number, estimation_unit_sequence_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_identifier, estimation_unit, stratum_code, state_code; notable measures: stratum_description, phase_1_point_count, phase_2_point_count, expansion_factor, multiple adjustment_factor_* fields (macroplot, subplot, microplot, CWD, fine woody debris, duff and litter, piles, regen/micro, etc.), and audit columns pop_stratum_created_by/modified_by and dates/instances.
population_evaluation_group: Holds evaluation group definitions; grain = one row per evaluation group (evaluation_group_sequence_number) with keys/ids: evaluation_group_sequence_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_group; notable fields: evaluation_group_description, state_code, notes, and audit columns pop_evaluation_group_created_by/modified_by and dates/instances.
condition: Holds condition-level measurements/classifications for plots; grain = one row per condition record (sequence_number) with keys/ids: sequence_number, plot_sequence_number, inventory_year, state_code, survey_unit_code, county_code, phase_2_plot_number, condition_class_number; notable measures/attributes: condition_status_code and names, condition_nonsampled_reason_code, reserved_status_code, ownership codes (owner_class_code, owner_group_code, private_owner_industrial_status_code), administrative_forest_code, forest_type_code and field_forest_type_code, mapping_density, stand_age, standsize_class_code, site_productivity_class_code, site_index_for_the_condition, site_index_base_age.
population_evaluation: Holds evaluations (analyses/reports) metadata; grain = one row per evaluation (evaluation_sequence_number) with keys/ids: evaluation_sequence_number, evaluation_group_sequence_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_identifier; notable fields: evaluation_description, state_code, location_name, report_year_name, start_inventory_year, end_inventory_year, flags land_only, timberland_only, growth_accounting, estimation_method, notes, and audit columns pop_evaluation_created_by/modified_by and dates/instances.
population_estimation_unit: Holds estimation unit definitions and areas; grain = one row per estimation unit (estimation_unit_sequence_number) with keys/ids: estimation_unit_sequence_number, evaluation_sequence_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_identifier, estimation_unit; notable measures: estimation_unit_description, state_code, land_area_within_the_estimation_unit, total_area_within_the_estimation_unit, area_used_to_calculate_all_expansion_factors, area_source, phase_1_point_count_for_the_estimation_unit, phase_1_source, and audit columns eval_unit_created_by/modified_by and dates/instances.
population_evaluation_type: Holds types for evaluations; grain = one row per evaluation type (evaluation_type_sequence_number) with keys/ids: evaluation_type_sequence_number, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_sequence_number; notable field: evaluation_type and audit columns eval_type_created_by/modified_by and dates/instances.
population: Holds combined population-level denormalized records (joins of stratum, estimation unit, and evaluation); grain = one row per population record (stratum_assign_sequence_number) with keys/ids: stratum_assign_sequence_number, stratum_sequence_number, plot_sequence_number, state_code, inventory_year, survey_unit_code, county_code, phase_2_plot_number, region_or_station_code, evaluation_identifier, estimation_unit, stratum_code, estimation_unit_sequence_number, evaluation_sequence_number, evaluation_group_sequence_number; notable measures/fields: estimation_unit_description, land_area_within_the_estimation_unit, total_area_within_the_estimation_unit, area_used_to_calculate_all_expansion_factors, area_source, phase_1_point_count_for_the_estimation_unit, phase_1_source, evaluation_description, location_name, report_year_name, start_inventory_year, end_inventory_year, land_only, and audit columns for stratum_assign and eval_unit creation/modification.
